scope: All 208 source frames of R30/R31 rendered at native 4K with phase, shot, subtitles and anchor checks. Twelve native PNGs for human review, three exact repeat-render comparisons after a seek, six exact unaffected-frame comparisons. Passing machine checks do not establish anatomy, cat-ear symmetry, logos, continuous human visual acceptance or audio.

source_comparison.name: art.js
allowed_changes: Use the approved cat source manifest

source_comparison.name: early.js
allowed_changes: R30 pose cuts at source frames 4965 and 5051, with sub-frame floating tolerance
R30 input grid stays on the left and fades there during the response
R30 output line approaches the real hand from below and avoids the face
R30 response waves travel left and down away from the face
R30 purr caption uses the left negative space

unaffected_comparison_context: Independent cold browser; one new page per variant; identical six-frame rendering order. Strict PNG SHA256 equality, including source frame 5125. Earlier seek-history font antialias diagnostic retained separately.
